conceptZh: 一隻高高的玩具長頸鹿和一台矮矮的小機器人想一起拍合照，第一次長頸鹿的頭出了畫面，第二次機器人整個被擋住；最後長頸鹿乾脆整隻趴下來，兩個人臉貼臉終於剛剛好。
object: a tall toy giraffe, a short toy robot and a tiny tripod camera
morph: the glyph 高 stands still as a solid sculpture while the mismatched pair try to fit into one photo
creativeAngle: 用拍照框不進去把高矮差距變成看得見的問題，三次嘗試的節奏很清楚，結尾長頸鹿趴下來遷就朋友也很可愛。高十畫、上中下三段堆疊，中間兩個口最容易畫糊，字體靜止並要求各段分明。語音詞「高手」，手ㄕㄡˇ已學過，兩字都是單一讀音。
promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second 3D stylized toy animation as one continuous locked-off shot on a clean solid pale cream background. One correctly formed Traditional Chinese character 高 stands centered the whole time as a flat-fronted sculpture in saturated deep teal blue, filling about 70% of the frame height with comfortable margins on all sides. Use standard textbook proportions: the small top stroke and dot, the 口 beneath them, and the lower section with its own 口 inside stay clearly separated as three stacked bands, none of them merging. The glyph never moves, rotates, tilts or gets covered, and the camera stays locked. Along its base a tall toy giraffe and a short boxy toy robot shuffle together in front of a tiny tripod camera, getting ready for a photo. At 1.0 second they pose: the giraffe's head is entirely out of frame above, leaving only legs and neck. They regroup. At 1.9 seconds the giraffe crouches to help and now its body completely hides the robot, whose small hand waves helplessly from behind a knee. They regroup again, both looking at the camera for guidance. Beat. At 2.9 seconds the giraffe simply lies all the way down on its belly and rests its chin on the floor, and the robot trots over and presses his cheek right beside it - and at last the two faces sit side by side, exactly the same height, both beaming. They hold the pose happily until 4.4 seconds, then amble out of frame to the left with the tripod. From 4.7 seconds to 8.0 seconds the frame is completely still and clean, holding on the single centered 高 with nothing else in shot. Style: Pixar-like glossy chunky toy materials, soft studio lighting, bright high-contrast colors that are vivid but never neon, no dark or moody grading, no white blowouts. Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks clear Taiwanese Mandarin and says exactly 「高、高、高手」, using the reading ㄍㄠ for 高 both on its own and inside the word. Speak the first 高 around 0.5 seconds, the second around 2.0 seconds, and 高手 around 5.6 seconds while the finished glyph is held still, with natural pauses, then stop; do not keep chanting the character or repeat the line. Keep every sound effect soft and clear of the voice, and use no music louder than the voice. The spoken word is audio only and must not be added to the picture. The only writing anywhere in the frame is the single character 高: no subtitles, no vocabulary text, no other letters, numbers, watermarks, scenery, extra props, particles, lens flare, motion blur on the glyph, or flashing effects.

conceptZh: 橡膠恐龍短手搆不到高處的積木，只好踩著越疊越高的盒子，最後疊出「高」。
object: rubber dinosaur with tiny arms, stacking boxes
morph: stacked boxes form the roof dot, a lid, and the boxes of 高
creativeAngle: 小手搆不到，叫道具一層層疊高。
promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second animated comedy, locked frontal camera. Setting: a sky-blue backdrop with a sandy floor; the glyph is made of violet toy boxes: a top dot, a wide lid bar, and a stacked mouth-shaped frame below. A rubber dinosaur with enormous feet and tiny arms stands at left. The Traditional Chinese glyph 高 stays centered and uncropped at about 70% of frame height with generous margins. Moment one (0.0-1.8s): the dino stretches both tiny arms toward a top box and cannot reach it, feet stomping once; the first 高 is spoken as it jumps in vain. Moment two (1.8-3.5s): it kicks a box bar into place, hops up on it, then the whole pile wobbles; boxes fall into the exact 高 arrangement, ending in a tall tower on the right; the second 高 is spoken as the top dot lands. Moment three (3.5-5.0s): a small toy mountain with a snowy tip rises behind the dino, which spreads its tiny arms toward it; 高山 is spoken as the peak pops up. From 5.0-8.0s the glyph 高 is perfectly still and unobstructed; the dino rocks proudly on its big feet and gives a tiny arm wave; the glyph is still. Voice: a gentle off-screen narrator in Taiwanese Mandarin pronounces exactly 「高、高、高山」 with Zhuyin ㄍㄠ、ㄍㄠ、ㄍㄠ ㄕㄢ, slowly and distinctly, tones clear. Timing: first utterance at about 0.5s, second at about 2.6s, the word at about 4.4s; then stop, no repeats and no extra speech. Beneath the voice only thumps and wooden clacks, no music. The single glyph is the only on-screen text; the vocabulary stays audio-only with no subtitles, watermark, clutter or flashing.
